issue.title: Bound _tools_cache and AgentSnapshotCache._GLOBAL_CACHE, whose eviction APIs never run
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY: phase sase-zn.9.3 (epic sase-zn.9, "Finish ACE typing-lag correctness and measured acceptance") note #3, routed here by the sase-zn.9 land agent on 2026-09-14. Re-verified unfixed at current HEAD.

Two module-level ACE TUI caches grow without bound. Both were confirmed during sase-zn.9.3's live heap-attribution work but triaged out of that phase because a correct fix needs more than a size cap; they grow with distinct-agent count rather than elapsed time, so they are slower than the per-second sites that phase bounded (commit e5f902ddd6).

1. `src/sase/ace/tui/tools/cache.py::_tools_cache` — keyed by agent identity and rewritten repeatedly for a still-running agent (the same hot-rewrite hazard sase-zn.9.3 fixed with LRU in `_linked_deltas.py` and `axe_log_renderer.py`). `invalidate_cached_tool_calls()` only mutates an existing entry, never pops one, so entries for dismissed/finished agents persist for the process lifetime.

2. `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_snapshot_cache.py::_GLOBAL_CACHE` (`AgentSnapshotCache`) — has `invalidate()`/`invalidate_dismissed_bundles()` methods, but grep confirms no production caller ever invokes them: a dead eviction API sitting on a monotonically growing dict.

Fix shape (established by sase-zn.9.3): bounded eviction that protects hot live entries — real LRU (`OrderedDict.move_to_end`) rather than FIFO, since FIFO evicts the busiest live agent first — plus wiring the existing invalidation APIs to real dismissal/cleanup paths, with a per-cache regression proving a hot entry survives while cold ones cycle out (see tests added by e5f902ddd6 for the pattern).

task_type_fields.impact: Long-lived ACE sessions on busy hosts retain per-agent cache entries indefinitely, contributing to residual RSS growth (see sase-v3's 2.3-2.5 GB idle measurement).
task_type_fields.repro: grep -n 'invalidate' src/sase/ace/tui/tools/cache.py src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_snapshot_cache.py — invalidate_cached_tool_calls mutates but never pops; no production caller of AgentSnapshotCache.invalidate*/invalidate_dismissed_bundles exists (grep -rn 'invalidate_dismissed_bundles' src/). Entries accumulate per distinct agent for the life of the TUI process.
